cause: serde_json generic Value projection promotes typed f32 material colors to f64, whereas native JSON writes shortest round-trippable f32 decimals. The original saved/inspect mismatch is confined to those three color numbers.
production_fix: project_inspect serializes validated typed Project to JSON bytes, then parses Value; existing inspect-sewing already uses the same pattern. Both MCP protocol profiles share this call path.
semantic_evidence: Real-stdio test compares actual saved native JSON exactly; f32 material bits and f64 point/cubic-control/placement bits including negative zero are unchanged; text and structured results agree; source file remains unchanged.
